label: 联盟失联后自行行动
meaning: Depict the steel oath tower episode as one readable local instance of the alliance operating after remote command is lost: Bran opens a civilian side gate, Cain activates his own service line, forge workers relieve pressure, and residents leave. The final novel explicitly places these actions together. This is not a depiction of every one of the four distant fronts at once; it preserves the canonical episode without a tiny four-panel collage.
timing: During the loss-of-contact overload and evacuation, before victory and before the later renewed mandate. No Leia orders, dragon rescue, victory celebration, council ritual, throne or crown are shown.
identities: Cain matches approved char-cain-02 navy/brass armor, burgundy cape and round shield. Bran matches approved char-bran-02 brown hair, olive hood, bow/quiver and scout kit. The forge worker and civilians are unnamed supporting people. Existing character identity symbols are inherited; no new faction flags or emblems are introduced.
visualConcretization: The broken high cable and local lever/pressure wheel make lost command and locally maintained service legible. Their exact hardware shapes are illustrative concretizations of the prose service interfaces rather than claims of separately established prop canon.
